open.speaker: nii
open.text: Where did you get THIS? Chale, this model is older than my little brother.

choices.text: It was under our floor. I think it's Kojo's.
It's an old phone of mine.
Can you just charge it? No questions.

truth.speaker: nii
truth.text: Under the FLOOR? …The guy at the gate. Then don't let anybody see it, okay? Not the porter, not the hall master. Nobody.

lie.speaker: nii
lie.text: Yours. With "K.B." scratched on the back. Okay, {name}. Okay.

noq.speaker: nii
noq.text: No questions is extra ₵10. I'm joking. Mostly.

charge.speaker: nii
charge.text: There — my magic drawer always has the one. …It's alive. PIN-locked. And who is this big man in the photo with the gold earring?

dunno.speaker: nii
dunno.text: Half this campus wears a gold stud, my friend. Leave it charging. Your lecture — don't you have a lecture?

end.speaker: nii
end.text: "Yet." Listen to you. Go and check your timetable, detective.
